RBAC: who really has access to your data?

takeaways: Default inherited workspace permissions and hardcoded secrets are the biggest silent risks in Microsoft Fabric pipelines.
Managed identities remove passwords from pipelines, and Azure Key Vault centralises the remaining secrets with logged, identity-scoped access.
Intentional, regularly reviewed role-based access control keeps pipeline edit and data access aligned with least privilege and makes audits provable.
hook: Fabric admins and data engineers whose pipelines look secure until an audit starts will learn where the default settings leave gaps. The episode shows how managed identities, Azure Key Vault and deliberate RBAC close those gaps without slowing teams down.
